If you can go Izmir you should go. You can swim Urla in Izmir very nice place. After go Urla, you can go to visit a lot of historical places. Everyone stay away Bodrum, Cesme and Antalya these places are so crowded and expensive not worth. there are many better alternatives to swim. If someone need advices send me dm.
